_README: Which library photos may be shown, and for what.
Two sections. "photos" is a verdict per library folder, from two
label-free reads of its images plus a third read where those two
disagreed. "exercises" assigns a folder to an exercise name.
Assignment is BY CONTENT. An exercise claims the folder whose
photos were read as showing that movement -- not the folder whose
NAME scores best against it. Folder names are the thing this audit
disproved: "barbell squat" holds front squat photos, "cable shrugs"
photo_key: null is a recorded answer -- nothing verified depicts
this exercise -- and the app shows no image rather than the
verdict "unresolved" means the readers did not agree. Those are
not served and are what the human review page is for.
_method: two blind vision reads per folder; a third where they split
